body.heading: Where in the world is Marshall Islands?
paragraphs: Marshall Islands is a country in Micronesia, which is part of Oceania. It is an island country, surrounded by sea.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Marshall Islands is Majuro.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: People in Marshall Islands speak Marshallese and English.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Marshall Islands is the US dollar. Yes — the very same dollars used in the United States!

body.heading: How big is Marshall Islands?
paragraphs: Marshall Islands covers about 181 square kilometres of land and inland water.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Bikini Atoll's lagoon holds a fleet of sunken WWII warships — now a UNESCO-listed diving museum where sharks patrol ghost ships on the sea floor.
Majuro Atoll's road ends at Laura, where the island's best beach meets a wide lagoon — families picnic under palms and swim in warm shallows.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find Marshall Islands on a map or globe. Which continent is it nearest to — and what sea or ocean surrounds it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?
